problem: The live NL→EN route switch reached the correct destination, but the production verifier timed out waiting for the full window load event.
root_cause: The acceptance test coupled route correctness to all page assets completing load. That can fail on slow non-critical resources even when navigation, DOM and localized route are correct.
prevention: Locale navigation readback waits for DOMContentLoaded instead of the full load event.
The verifier still requires the exact target pathname, expected html lang and visible localized content.
The canonical i18n asset version is rotated so the final production run proves the exact runtime.
